rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Analyzes git commit history to reveal hidden file dependencies and coupling patterns that static analysis misses. Uses multiple analytical engines including volatility detection for bug-prone code, entanglement analysis for files that change together, and sentinel tracking for stale dependencies. Runs entirely locally using the .git folder with no cloud uploads or API keys required.
